The 'Add Customer' button in the New Work Order flow when Customers Create & Edit is OFF
current_excerpt: The Add Customer button is not shown in the customer picker; the user can still pick an existing customer but cannot create a new one. (Known deviation: a prior run found this button still appearing when Customers Create & Edit is off — recommend a live re-check.)

proposed_text.custom_expected:
The Add Customer button IS shown in the customer picker, and creating a new customer from the New Work Order flow works.

This is the expected behaviour: inside the New Work Order flow, adding a customer is part of creating a work order and is available to anyone who can create a work order (Work Orders: Create & Edit). It does NOT require Customers: Create & Edit — and in fact works even if Customers: View is OFF. The Customers permission only controls the Customers area in the top navigation.

reason: SV-8002 (Sasha 2026-06-30, fix verified 2026-07-07) reversed the original expectation: the Add Customer button must be VISIBLE and creating a customer in the New WO flow works without any Customers CRUD. The old 'button hidden' expectation is inverted — a clear nightly false-fail source.
citation: SV-8002 Sasha Grosman 2026-06-30 + QA Passed 2026-07-07; spec Key Decision 'Data Access not addressed' / Open Question 10.

title: The 'Add Asset' button is hidden in the New Work Order flow when Customers Create & Edit is OFF
current_excerpt: The Add Asset button is not shown; the user can pick an existing asset but cannot create a new one. (Known deviation: a prior run found this button still appearing when Customers Create & Edit is off — recommend a live re-check.)

proposed_text.title: The 'Add Asset' button in the New Work Order flow when Customers Create & Edit is OFF
proposed_text.custom_expected:
The Add Asset button IS shown, and adding a new asset for the customer from the New Work Order flow works.

This is the expected behaviour: inside the New Work Order flow, adding an asset is part of creating a work order and is available to anyone who can create a work order (Work Orders: Create & Edit). It does NOT require Customers: Create & Edit.

reason: SV-8002 explicitly covers creating both customers AND assets in the New WO flow ('create customers and assets in the create WO flow'; QA verified 'add asset for that customer from New Work Order Flow'). The 'button hidden' expectation is inverted.

title: Order parts controls the work order Parts tab (on shows it, off hides it)
Edit/delete options on another user's customer note are hidden without the right permission
current_excerpt: PRE: role A with Customers View and Work orders View but no Work orders Delete. (steps/expected empty stub; premise gates a CUSTOMER note on Work orders Delete)

proposed_text.title: Customer notes: editing anyone's note needs Customers View; deleting another user's note needs Customers Delete
proposed_text.custom_preconds:
1. A customer has a note on its Notes tab that was written by a DIFFERENT user (e.g. an admin).
  2. Role A has Customer Management: View only (no Delete). Role B has Customer Management: View + Create & Edit + Delete.
  3. You can sign in as a user on Role A and as a user on Role B.
proposed_text.custom_steps:
1. Sign in as the Role A user (Customers: View only) and open the customer's Notes tab.
  2. Try to edit the note written by the other user.
  3. Try to delete the note written by the other user.
  4. Sign in as the Role B user (Customers: Delete) and open the same Notes tab.
  5. Try to delete the note written by the other user.
proposed_text.custom_expected:
Role A (Customers: View) CAN edit the other user's note (Work Orders/Customers View allows editing anyone's note so people can collaborate in one note), and can delete its OWN notes, but the Delete option on ANOTHER user's note is not available.

Role B (Customers: Delete) CAN delete the other user's note.

Customer and Asset notes are gated by the Customer Management permission (View = create + edit anyone's + delete own; Delete = delete others'). Work Orders: Delete does NOT control customer notes.

reason: Final Notes model (SV-8003, Sasha 2026-07-08, verified 07-14): customer notes follow Customer Management CRUD, not Work Orders. Editing anyone's note is allowed with View; only deleting OTHERS' notes needs Delete. The stub premise gated a customer note on Work Orders Delete and implied edit is hidden — both wrong.
citation: SV-8003 Sasha Grosman 2026-07-08 (final Notes model); spec §1d Customers View/Delete.

title: A Pick/Order Parts role can edit the Quantity on the Part Requests tab
current_excerpt: PRE: Work order lines View only, and Pick parts ON. Title asserts a Pick/Order Parts (WOL View-only) role CAN edit part quantity.
proposed_text: OPEN QUESTION for Bilal/Vlad: two PO inputs conflict on which permission gates changing a part's quantity on a WO line. SV-8136 (Sasha 2026-07-06, QA Passed 07-14): 'They should only need WOL: Create & Edit to manage the quantity of a part' — i.e. a WOL View-only role (even with Pick/Order Parts) should NOT be able to change quantity. SV-8055 (referenced in SV-8136): 'On a work order's Parts tab, the user can edit part information even if their role has no WO Lines: Create and Edit permission.' Case C29435 asserts a Pick-Parts + WOL-View-only role CAN edit quantity, matching SV-8055 but contradicting SV-8136's WOL-C&E ruling. Case is Blocked-UI (never verified live). Decide: keep as WOL-C&E-gated (retire/rewrite this Pick-Parts-only case) or confirm the Parts-tab exception. Do not push until resolved.
reason: SV-8136 (newer explicit PM ruling) says quantity management needs WOL Create & Edit; SV-8055 suggests a Parts-tab exception. Genuine spec tension on a never-verified case — needs a human decision, not a silent rewrite.
citation: SV-8136 Sasha Grosman 2026-07-06 (WOL C&E) vs SV-8055 (Parts-tab edit without WOL C&E).

title: Work order lines are visible whenever Work orders View is ON
Work order lines Create & Edit allows adding, editing, moving parts, authorizing and managing part requests
Work order lines Delete allows removing lines
Work orders View OFF makes work order lines unreachable
Work order lines are read-only when Create & Edit is OFF
The Build Lines entry point is hidden for a Work Orders View-only role
The Build Lines entry point is shown for a role with Work order lines Create & Edit
A default Technician (with Work order lines Create & Edit) can bulk-complete another tech's line via Set Line Status
Work order lines Create & Edit lets the user mark a core OK/Not-OK and add line history
current_excerpt: The core OK / Not OK control is available to this role and saves ... Both marking the core and adding line history are controlled by Work order lines Create & Edit.

proposed_text.title: Marking a core OK/Not-OK is available with Work orders View; a line's story history is available with Work order lines View
proposed_text.custom_expected:
The core OK / Not OK control is available and saves. A line's story history can be opened.

Marking a core OK/Not-OK is gated by Work Orders: View (everyone who can view a work order can do it — agreed as a shared capability), and a line's story history is gated by Work Order Lines: View (which is inherited from Work Orders: View). A Work Order Lines: Create & Edit role therefore has both, but they are NOT exclusive to Create & Edit. (Line-level audit log, by contrast, requires Work Orders: Create & Edit.)

reason: Cores OK/Not-OK moved to Work Orders: View (SV-8130 + spec 7/7 Key Decision 'agreed with Cody everyone should have access'); story history moved to WOL View (SV-7989, spec 7/7). The case's claim that both are 'controlled by WOL Create & Edit' contradicts the current spec even though a WOL C&E role still has both.
citation: Spec 7/7 changelog + Key Decision (cores = WO View); SV-7989 Sasha 2026-07-07 (story history = WOL View, audit log = WO C&E); SV-8130 verified 07-13.
